card.text: Explore YORP in 3D with its published radar shape model.

introduction.text: YORP is a small near-Earth asteroid with a radar-derived flattened northern hemisphere and a prominent concavity. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. Its rotation information refers to the 2001 reference epoch.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Radar shape with stronger coverage in the north. Rotation uses a fixed rate, not a current attitude model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Radar height relative to a 56.4 m sphere. A quarter had poor or no coverage; the polar shape is uncertain.
